note.question: What determines a class of neural network–based discrete choice models, called RUMnets, inspired by the random utility maximization (RUM) framework?
note.overview: Motivated by the successes of deep learning, we propose a class of neural network–based discrete choice models, called RUMnets, inspired by the random utility maximization (RUM) framework. This model formulates the agents’ random utility function using a sample average approximation. The paper shows that RUMnets sharply approximate the class of RUM discrete choice models: Any model derived from random utility maximization has choice probabilities that can be approximated arbitrarily closely by a RUMnet.
